The *Kenaciviññeyyaduka, Kusalattika* is an Abhidhamma text belonging to the *Paṭṭhāna* (*Patthana 15.31*), the seventh and final treatise of the Pali Abhidhamma Piṭaka [SuttaCentral]. It forms part of the complex combinatorial matrices of the *Paṭṭhāna*, specifically treating the conditional relationships arising from the synthesis of the *Kenaciviññeyyaduka* (the dyad of states cognizable by certain means) with the *Kusalattika* (the triad of wholesome, unwholesome, and indeterminate states) [SuttaCentral].
